lead_raw_text:
The structure of La2MnGa crystallizes in the cubic space group P2₁3 (No. 1), with a unit cell containing four atoms—two La, one Ga, and one Mn—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows each Ga and Mn center has eight La neighbors, while each La center has four Ga and four Mn neighbors, all at 3.1861 Å and described as body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all four sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing among La-centered 8-vertex polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between Ga- and Mn-centered polyhedra.
